title: Bank Deposit Pricing Rules: Transfer Fee, Surcharges, Customer Rate, Amount Received and Date of Availability
content:
Every Bank Deposit transfer is priced once, at booking, from the tier's fee schedule, its margin terms and the Paloma rate sheet. The price disclosed before payment is made of the transfer fee, any surcharge, the customer exchange rate, the amount the recipient receives and the date of availability.

## 1. Transfer fee

1.1 The transfer fee is the fee of the tier's principal band whose lower and upper bounds contain the principal.
1.2 When the transfer is funded by pay-by-bank, the tier's pay-by-bank discount is taken off that fee, never below 0.00.
1.3 A transfer is the customer's first personal transfer when no other personal transfer exists on the sender account in Bank Deposit, Cash Pickup or Mobile Wallet, except ones whose status is cancelled or refunded.
1.4 On a first transfer booked on a tier whose fee-waiver term is yes and whose principal is at or below the tier's promotion cap, the transfer fee is 0.00 and the margin is the tier's promotional margin. Above the cap the regular price applies to the whole transfer.
1.5 The first-transfer promotion and the pay-by-bank discount never stack: when the promotion applies, the fee is already 0.00.

## 2. Surcharge

The surcharge is the card funding fee for a credit card (the tier's credit card percentage of the principal, rounded half up to the cent), the tier's debit card fee for a debit card, the OUR surcharge for an OUR wire, and 0.00 otherwise.

## 3. Margin and customer rate

3.1 The margin is the tier's exchange-rate margin, less the tier's reduction in percentage points when the principal is at or above the tier's reduction threshold. The promotional margin replaces both and is never reduced further.
3.2 The customer rate is the corridor's mid-market rate in the Paloma rate sheet for the booking date (the date part of the booking moment), multiplied by one minus the margin over 100, rounded half up to 4 decimals.

## 4. Amount received

4.1 The amount received is the principal multiplied by the customer rate, rounded half up to the corridor's decimals: 0 decimals for Vietnam (VN-VND) and 2 decimals for every other corridor.
4.2 On an SHA wire the tier's intermediary deduction estimate is first taken off the principal before conversion and is disclosed as an estimate; on an OUR wire nothing is taken off.

## 5. Date of availability

5.1 The date is counted from the release day. Release is on the booking day when the booking is on a Paloma business day at or before the tier's cut-off (every day for 24x7 tiers); otherwise on the next Paloma business day. ACH settlement waits and new-recipient cooling-off under the Personal Sender Account rules move the release later.
5.2 The tier's delivery time in Paloma business days is then added. On a tier with weekend payout, the resulting date may fall on any calendar day.

## 6. Collection and finality

6.1 Fees are collected with the principal as fee charges on the transfer's ledger: the transfer fee when above 0.00, the card funding fee and the OUR surcharge, each against payout attempt 1.
6.2 Fees and limits are never recalculated after booking except by a re-quote, a resend or a refund rule.

## Worked examples (hypothetical principals and rates)

| Case | Working | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Bank Deposit Economy, 1200.00 by ACH debit to MX-MXN, mid-market 18.5000, not a first transfer | band fee 2.99; margin 0.95 (below the 5000.00 threshold); rate 18.5000 multiplied by one minus 0.95 over 100 is 18.32425, rounded to 18.3243; amount received 1200.00 multiplied by 18.3243 | fee 2.99, surcharge 0.00, rate 18.3243, amount received 21989.16 |
| Bank Deposit Express, 800.00 by credit card | band fee 4.99; card funding fee 3.00 percent of 800.00 | fee 4.99, surcharge 24.00 |
| Bank Deposit Standard, 500.00 by pay-by-bank | band fee 2.99 less the 1.00 discount | fee 1.99 |
| Bank Deposit Economy, first transfer of 600.00 | at or below the 1000.00 cap on a fee-waiver tier | fee 0.00, margin 0.00 percent |
| Bank Deposit Economy, first transfer of 1500.00 | above the cap: regular price on the whole transfer | fee 2.99, margin 0.95 percent |
| Bank Deposit International Wire, 1000.00, SHA | 15.00 estimate taken off before conversion | 985.00 converted; fee 24.99; surcharge 0.00 |
| Bank Deposit International Wire, 1000.00, OUR | nothing taken off | 1000.00 converted; fee 24.99; surcharge 20.00 |

*Hypothetical date example:* a Bank Deposit Standard transfer booked at 16:10 US Central on a Paloma business day is after the 15:00 cut-off, so it is released on the next Paloma business day, and its date of availability is one Paloma business day after that release.
